text:
Aisha (AE): Hey team — Rowan (enterprise buyer) wants a tight checklist before committing to a POC. Key asks: SSO/SAML session handling, SCIM bulk onboarding, RBAC for delegated admins, domain verification proofing, and an estimate for Hosted vs Dedicated cost. Can we summarize blockers and what we need to answer?

Diego (Sales Eng): Quick bullets from me: 1) SAML: assertion lifetime, NameID formats, logout behavior, ACS endpoints. 2) SCIM: bulk import speed and backoff policy, PATCH support, supported attrs. 3) RBAC: can they map Okta groups -> app roles + delegated tenant-admin? 4) Domain controls: how we do domain claim + DNS proofing for email login.

Maya (Security): Add: KMS integration requirements, audit log retention for admin actions, and SAML metadata signing algorithm (we support SHA256). Also need to confirm whether customer requires Signed Assertions *and* Signed Responses.

Noah (Platform PM): On pricing: for a short POC we can do hosted API credits; Dedicated minimum is 4 GPUs reserved (monthly commit) — we should give a rough cost delta and the runbook for moving from Hosted -> Dedicated. Also call out egress/data residency costs if they insist on EU-only.

Aisha (AE): Rowan asked specifically about assertion TTL — they want 24h SSO sessions and 1h token validity for API calls. Is that supported?

Diego (Sales Eng): Yes. We support session TTLs configured in the IdP mapping layer. For token lifetimes for our API sessions we recommend short-lived tokens (1h) and rotating refresh tokens behind their auth proxy. Will confirm exact config keys.

Jin (SRE): Regarding SCIM bulk: our current rate limiter defaults to 120 req/min per tenant for SCIM endpoints. We have a documented exponential backoff when we return 429s. Example header: `X-RateLimit-Remaining: 42`. For very large imports we recommend the CSV -> batched PATCH flow.

Diego (Sales Eng): I'll paste a sample SCIM PATCH snippet Rowan can hand to their IdP team:
```
PATCH /scim/v2/Users/12345
Content-Type: application/json
{
  "schemas": ["urn:ietf:params:scim:api:messages:2.0:PatchOp"],
  "Operations": [
    {"op":"add","path":"members","value":[{"value":"group-789"}]}
  ]
}
```

Maya (Security): For SAML specifics: we support HTTP-POST and HTTP-Redirect bindings for ACS; NameID formats: transient, persistent, emailAddress. We can require SignedAssertion=true and SignedResponse=optional. We'll need to collect their IdP metadata XML and a contact. Also run their security questionnaire (they attached a 30p doc) — checklist items I need answered: org-wide KMS, MFA enforcement for admins, SCIM provisioning audit trail retention (90 days or more?), and whether they need cert rotation window shorter than 30 days.

Aisha (AE): Rowan also flagged delegated admins: they want a tenant-admin role who can manage users but not modify billing. Can our RBAC model do role separation like that?

Noah (Platform PM): Yes — our RBAC supports role-scoped permissions. We have built-in roles: tenant-admin, billing-admin, read-only. You can map IdP groups to those roles at tenant creation time or via SCIM group-to-role sync. We'll note that delegated admin creation is a UI+API flow and needs audit logs enabled.

Rowan (Customer): Quick Q from my side: for domain verification, what's the shortest DNS proof TTL we accept? Our infra team prefers CNAME verification so they can automate.

Jin (SRE): We accept TXT or CNAME proof. We check TXT within our provisioning job every 30s for up to 15 minutes; if you need faster automation we can run a manual poll via support. Shortest practical is ~30s but depends on registrar propagation.

Diego (Sales Eng): Action items I'm capturing for the POC doc: - Provide SAML metadata checklist + sample configs - Provide SCIM bulk import best-practices + rate-limit doc - Provide RBAC mapping examples + API call list - Provide domain verification step-by-step (TXT & CNAME) - Draft Hosted vs Dedicated cost delta + egress residency caveats

Maya (Security): Also attaching required answers for their security questionnaire: KMS (supported integrations: AWS KMS, GCP KMS, HashiCorp Vault via HSM connector), retention windows, cert rotation policy. I'll own the sec questionnaire responses.

Aisha (AE): Timeline? Rowan wants a POC kickoff next Tue. Can we have the doc and sample configs by EOD Friday?

Diego (Sales Eng): I can draft the config snippets today.

Noah (Platform PM): I'll prepare the pricing delta & Dedicated sizing options by Friday noon.

Maya (Security): I'll fill out the questionnaire draft and put any blockers in a separate sheet — aiming EOD Friday.

Jin (SRE): I'll export current SCIM rate metrics and a short ops note about retries/alerts.

Aisha (AE): Great — if anyone hits a blocker tag @aisha. Rowan, thanks — we'll send the POC checklist and schedule a tech call. :thumbsup:
